project_context.name: AutoDetail Pro
project_context.description: A dark, premium, single-page marketing website to showcase luxury auto detailing services, pricing, and portfolio, driving conversions to WhatsApp.

surfaces.button_primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#C5A059] transition-colors font-medium rounded-none px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
surfaces.button_outline: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#D4AF37] transition-colors rounded-none px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

layout_strategy.hero: Full height (min-h-screen) with a cinematic car image background. Use a heavy gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/80 to-transparent`) to ensure text readability. Asymmetric alignment for text (left-aligned, mid-page).
layout_strategy.services_grid: Bento-style asymmetric grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8`). Some cards span 8 cols, others 4 cols to create visual tension and hierarchy.
layout_strategy.gallery: Masonry or overlapping high-contrast images. No standard symmetric squares.
layout_strategy.testimonials: Minimalist typography-heavy cards with large quote marks.
layout_strategy.contact_footer: Massive typography for 'Let's Talk', huge padding (`py-32`). Darker than base (`bg-black`).

components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/80`), 1px bottom border (`border-white/5`). Must have the Logo and a prominent 'Agendar WhatsApp' CTA.
components.services_card: Minimalist dark cards. Large price display (`text-4xl font-light text-white`). Delicate lines for list items. Call to action on hover.
components.faq: Use custom Radix/Shadcn accordion. Overriding default styles: transparent backgrounds, 1px bottom borders, gold accent on active.
components.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right corner. High z-index. Green (WhatsApp brand `#25D366`) but can be styled slightly darker or with glass to fit the premium theme, pulsating animation.

images.description: A dark cinematic sports car in a moody room. Use as main hero background with dark gradient overlay.
Cleaning luxury car interior steering wheel.

icons.usage: Use icons with thin stroke-width (1.5 or 1) to match the luxury typography. Wrap in small gold circles for list bullets.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Single Page Application (marketing site) focused on high conversions via WhatsApp.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Base dark is #050505. Surface is #121212.
Use framer-motion for elegant, slow reveal animations on scroll (`initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}}`).
Headings must use Outfit (add via Google Fonts) and Body must use Manrope.
Avoid border-radius (rounded-md/lg). Use sharp edges (`rounded-none`) to create a high-fashion, technical automotive look.
Floating WhatsApp button must be present at all times. Use fixed positioning and z-50.
In the Service Catalog, emphasize the prices visually.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, accordion triggers, navigation links) as per E1 critical rules.
Ensure all text over images or gradients has sufficient APCA contrast. Use text shadows if needed.
Install `lucide-react` for icons and `framer-motion` for animations.
Use standard HTML tags for layout structures (section, div, span) styled with Tailwind. Use Shadcn only for complex interactive components like Accordion (FAQ).
